title: Breach Predictor Dashboard views and the Threat Landscape page

{{secured-state}} The allowed time frames are open {{gap:time-frame-values}}.

layout.statement: The Dashboard is the first page shown at login; it consists of the Overall Breach Probability score, prioritized policy recommendations, Observed Users views and a Threat Overview.

quotes: When you first log in to the Breach Predictor Portal, the Dashboard page is the first thing you see.
It consists of the Overall Breach Probability score, prioritized policy recommendations, as well as Observed Users views and a Threat Overview

layout-two-areas.statement: The Dashboard is divided into two main areas: the Overall Breach Probability score and the MITRE ATT&CK Overview charts and graphs.

quotes: The Dashboard is divided into two main areas: the Overall Breach Probability score, and the MITRE ATT&CK Overview charts and graphs.

score-inputs.statement: On the Dashboard page, the Overall Breach Probability score factors in the organization's placement in the MITRE ATT&CK matrix and the number of affected users; a higher score indicates a higher risk of a data breach.

quotes: The score factors in your organization's placement in the MITRE ATT&CK matrix, as well as the number of affected users. A higher Overall Breach Probability score indicates a higher risk of a data breach.

score-reading.statement: A higher Overall Breach Probability score indicates movement into critical stages by threat actors and a high number of affected users.

quotes: A higher Overall Breach Probability score indicates movement into critical stages by threat actors, as well as a high number of users who are affected.

views.statement: The Dashboard consists of two Observed Users views and a Threat Overview view; the time frame can be set for the Sankey charts and graphs in each view.

quotes: The Dashboard consists of two Observed Users views and a Threat Overview view
You can specify the time frame for the data you see in the Sankey charts and graphs in each of the available views.

view-toggle.statement: The left and right arrows toggle between Observed Users views, and Explore opens the Findings page.

quotes: You can click the left and right arrows to toggle between Observed Users views
you can click Explore to open the Findings page

view1.statement: Observed Users view 1 is a horizontal Sankey chart with Users (total and at-risk users), Stages, Category and Malware Family columns; About Dashboard says the Malware Family column shows each family's name and severity score, and Analyzing Dashboard says the listing for each malware family indicates the number of users affected by that family.

quotes: The Sankey chart in the first Observed Users view uses a horizontal layout
In the Users column, see an overview for the total users in your organization, as well as the number of users at risk of a data breach.
In the Stages column, see the attack stage locations of the malware families affecting your users.
In the Category column, see the classification groups for the malware families affecting your users.
In the Malware Family column, see the names of the malware families affecting your users, as well as the severity score for each family.
Additionally, the listing for each malware family indicates the number of users affected by that family.

view2.statement: Observed Users view 2 is a vertical Sankey chart whose Total Users column shows the percentage change in users at risk, whose bottom row shows the number of users affected by each malware family, and in which attack stages that have not been reached are not interactive.

quotes: The Sankey chart in the second Observed Users view uses a vertical layout
In the Total Users column, see an overview for the total users in your organization, as well as the percentage change in users at risk of a data breach.
Attack stages that have not been reached are not interactive.
In the bottom row, see the names of the malware families affecting your users, as well as the number of users affected by each family.

threat-overview.statement: The Threat Overview view includes these charts: Top Users Impacted By Threats (Sankey), Top Threats Across Attack Stages (radial), Allowed Policies over time (bar) and Threats over time (bar).

quotes: In the Top Users Impacted By Threats Sankey chart, see the top users affected by the top malware threat.
In the Top Threats Across Attack Stages radial chart, see the main attack stages for the threats affecting your users.
In the Allowed Policies over time bar chart, see main policies that allowed the malware threats affecting your users.
In the Threats over time bar chart, see the threat families that have affected your users during the selected period.

secured-state.statement: If the organization is secured and no users are at risk during the specified time period, the Dashboard shows a link to the Threat Landscape page.

quotes: If your organization is secured and no users are at risk during the specified time period, Breach Predictor shows a link to the Threat Landscape page

threat-landscape.statement: The Threat Landscape page draws on Zscaler ThreatLabz data, including millions of results maintained in the Zscaler Threat Library.

quotes: The information provided on the Threat Landscape page comes from cutting-edge Zscaler ThreatLabz data and includes millions of results that are maintained in the Zscaler Threat Library.

threat-landscape-filters.statement: The Threat Landscape page can be filtered by threat severity, the policy engine related to the threat, and the product whose logs identified the threat, and searched by threat name or signature ID; it also shows the overall breach probability, a prioritized policy recommendation list and the biggest global threats identified by ThreatLabz.

quotes: Filter the results on the page by the severity of the threat, the policy engine related to the threat, and the product whose logs identified the threat.
Search to filter by threat name or by the signature ID.
View information about the overall breach probability for your organization.
View a prioritized list of policy recommendations.
View basic information about the threats that Zscaler ThreatLabz has identified as the biggest threats across the globe.

score-input-list.summary: About Dashboard lists two inputs to the Overall Breach Probability score (matrix placement, affected users), while What Is Zscaler Breach Predictor? lists three, adding the number of observed malware families.

positions.says: The score factors in the organization's placement in the MITRE ATT&CK matrix and the number of affected users.

quotes: The score factors in your organization's placement in the MITRE ATT&CK matrix, as well as the number of affected users.

positions.says: The score takes into account the number of observed malware families, their location on the matrix, and the number of affected users.

quotes: The score takes into account the number of observed malware families, their location on the MITRE ATT&CK matrix, and the number of affected users.

score-input-list.impact: Do not present either list as the complete set of score inputs; whether the malware family count is a separate input is unconfirmed.

time-frame-values.title: Which time frames the Dashboard, Findings, Events and Threat Landscape selectors allow, and how far back data goes
time-frame-values.detail: The captured articles say a time frame can be set but give no maximum time frame or allowed values for the selectors; log retention is up to a year depending on subscription SKU, per [[shared.logs-fair-use.log-retention:breach-predictor]], but the selector's range is not stated.
